messages:
alex (Product): heads-up — seeing 4 separate asks this week about per-tenant quotas / rate limits for Dedicated. thinking we should merge and triage as one canonical request.
priya (Support): tickets: #4589, #4621, #4640. common ask is "control per-tenant burst + total qps". small variations (some want admin UI, some want API).
marcus (Sales): +1. two prospects asked specifically about per-tenant billing + soft-limits for onboarding. want rough ETA to signal in deals.
lina (Eng PM): can you paste the ticket snippets? we need concrete acceptance criteria before scope.
jordan (CS): one of the tickets is an enterprise regulated customer asking for strict caps + audit logs. they flagged for compliance — is higher priority.
alex (Product): pasted snippets in thread.
priya (Support): snippet: "We need a hard cap per-tenant, with alert when close to cap. Admins must be able to set per-tenant daily token limits via API."
marcus (Sales): snippet from prospect: "soft limits + overage alerts + billing tie-in — want to onboard several teams without noisy throttling."
lina (Eng PM): proposal for canonical feature (draft scope):
- config API for tenant quota (tokens/sec, daily tokens)
- admin UI to view/set quotas (MVP: API only)
- enforcement at ingress gateway with transparent 429s
- telemetry + alerting hooks
- migration path for existing tenants
alex (Product): good. add: audit logs for changes (needed for compliance customers) and doc for recommended defaults.
jordan (CS): add SLA note: customers want predictable failure modes. recommend fallback policy (soft vs hard) in spec.
marcus (Sales): priority guidance: for prospects -> show ETA (PII: +1 quarter ok). they need a date to move forward.
lina (Eng PM): rough implementation estimate: 3 sprints for API + gateway enforcement + basic telemetry (team-level). UI extra sprint.
alex (Product): backlog tags to use when we merge threads: [customer-request, dedupe, needs-spec, priority-enterprise]
priya (Support): can we consolidate ticket references in a single backlog item and link the tickets? yes.
alex (Product): owner? Lina you ok to drive spec + PRD? I'll review and own customer comms.
lina (Eng PM): I can own it. will draft spec by EOW (Fri). will include acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and compat notes.
marcus (Sales): thanks. ask: can we include a note about billing integration being out of scope for MVP but tracked as follow-up?
lina (Eng PM): yes, mark billing integration as backlog follow-up with priority-low for now.
jordan (CS): please include template status update to send to all requesters. want to be able to respond quickly.
alex (Product): drafting canned reply — paste below for review:
```
Hi — thanks for the request. We're consolidating similar asks into a single engineering backlog item to avoid duplication and ensure consistent scope.
Planned next steps: product to create spec (ETA: Fri), engineering to estimate and schedule. Tentative timeline: alpha in ~8–10 weeks depending on capacity. We'll follow up with more accurate dates after spec review.
Workaround: tenant-level token throttling via reverse-proxy rules (we can assist with config).
If you need priority escalation, reply here and we'll route to CS/sales.
```
priya (Support): :thumbsup: I can send that to all 3 customers once Alex signs off.
marcus (Sales): :thumbsup: will let prospects know it's in consolidation and not blocked.
lina (Eng PM): quick question for spec: do we need per-route quotas (yes/no)? propose MVP supports tenant-wide quotas; per-route as follow-up.
alex (Product): agree MVP = tenant-wide only. per-route can be a later enhancement.
jordan (CS): noted. please include audit log fields: changed_by, timestamp, previous_value.
lina (Eng PM): adding that.
alex (Product): next actions:
- lina: draft spec + acceptance criteria by EOW
- alex: review + finalize canned reply
- priya: send canned reply to requesters after sign-off
- marcus/jordan: flag any customers who want escalation
I'll merge tickets into one backlog item and tag accordingly.
priya (Support): tickets merged into internal ticket #IT-9214. linking.
ticket-bot: created issue RDW-2107 in product board (linked to IT-9214)
alex (Product): perfect. thanks everyone. we'll update this thread with spec link once ready.
